watches.name: Shizen – 38MM – DLC Coated Field Watch – Fixed Lugs – IN STOCK
watches.description: SHIZEN — BUILT FOR EVERYDAY EXPLORATION Now IN STOCK – SAVE $150 USD – Launch Price Introducing the Shizen, our all-new 38mm field watch. Named after the Japanese word for “Nature,” the Shizen was designed from the ground up to be your everyday companion—ready to go wherever life takes you. We spent months refining every detail, focusing on the features that matter when a watch is expected to perform in any environment. The result is a purpose-built field watch that combines durability, legibility, reliability, and understated design in a compact 38mm package. The Shizen features our first-ever fixed-lug case design, eliminating traditional spring bars and helping prevent the risk of a broken watch pin causing you to lose your watch during demanding or extreme situations. For additional durability, the case is finished with a DLC (Diamond-Like Carbon) coating, providing a tough, highly wear-resistant surface designed to withstand the rigours of everyday exploration. The dial features hand-applied indices filled with industry-leading BGW9 Super-LumiNova, delivering excellent visibility in low-light conditions. A finely textured matte dial surface helps reduce reflections and enhances legibility, keeping the focus exactly where it belongs—the time. At the heart of the Shizen is the Miyota 9039 Japanese automatic movement, a proven and reliable movement chosen for its combination of performance, durability, and dependability. watches.name: Shibuya – Hachiko Special Edition – AndoAndoAndo Collaboration – Launching Nov 7
watches.description: Our Shibuya watch design was inspired by the Shibuya Crossing in Japan, the worlds busiest pedestrian crossing. FEATURES Seiko VH31 Meca Quartz Movement 39MM Case Size 20MM Lug Width 46.5MM Lug to Lug 11MM Case Height 100M Water Resistance Screw Down Engraved Crown AR Coated Sapphire Glass 2 – FKM Rubber Quick Release Straps BGW9 – Super Lume Blocks 316 Stainless Steel Hachiko – AndoAndoAndo Collaboration SHIBUYA — A Timeless Story of Loyalty Some bonds are so powerful that not even time can break them. For nearly ten years, a loyal dog returned to the same train station in Tokyo, waiting for someone who would never come home. His name was Hachikō , and his story became one of the world’s most enduring symbols of unconditional love and unwavering loyalty. FEATURES Seiko VH31 Meca Quartz Movement 39MM Case Size 20MM Lug Width 46.5MM Lug to Lug 11MM Case Height 100M Water Resistance Screw Down Engraved Crown AR Coated Sapphire Glass 2 – FKM Rubber Quick Release Straps BGW9 – Super Lume Blocks 316 Stainless Steel The Story That Inspired a Timepiece In 1924, a young Akita named Hachikō formed an extraordinary bond with his owner and best friend, Professor Hidesaburō Ueno. Each day, Hachikō would eagerly await the Professor’s return from work at Shibuya Station. Their daily reunion became a cherished ritual, a beautiful expression of love and companionship. But on May 21, 1925, tragedy struck. Professor Ueno passed away unexpectedly while at work, never to return home. Hachikō could not understand why his beloved companion had disappeared. Yet, he never gave up hope. For nearly ten years, Hachikō returned to Shibuya Station each day, through rain, snow, and changing seasons, faithfully waiting for his master and best friend. He continued returning until his own passing in Shibuya in 1935, still waiting for the reunion that would never come. Today, his statue stands outside Shibuya Station, a lasting tribute to a love that even time could not erase. Two Hands. One Unbreakable Bond. The Makoto Shibuya is a special collaboration between Makoto Watch Company and Ando Ando Ando, a Japanese designer now living in Finland . Together, we set out to create something more meaningful than simply another timepiece. We wanted to tell Hachikō’s remarkable story through thoughtful design, symbolism, and the very passage of time itself. The hour hand represents Hachikō. Moving slowly and steadily around the dial, it symbolizes his patience, devotion, and unwavering loyalty. The minute hand represents Professor Ueno . Its continuous movement symbolizes the Professor’s daily journey and the passing hours that brought them together. As the hands travel around the dial, they separate, draw closer, and eventually meet again, reflecting the daily reunions Hachikō cherished and continued to hope for. Every meeting of the hands symbolizes the reunion Hachikō spent the rest of his life waiting for. A Special Moment at 3 O’Clock One of the most meaningful details of the Shibuya is the distinctly coloured marker at the 3 o’clock position . This marker symbolically represents the afternoon return of Professor Ueno to Shibuya Station, the moment Hachikō would eagerly anticipate each day. A subtle but deeply meaningful design element, it captures the excitement of seeing someone you love and the joy of being reunited after time apart. A Love That Time Could Not Erase The world around Hachikō continued moving. Trains arrived and departed. Seasons changed. Years passed. But Hachikō never stopped waiting. Through our collaboration with Ando Ando Ando, we have captured this extraordinary devotion in a timepiece where every detail carries meaning. Every movement of the hands tells part of Hachikō’s story. Every meeting symbolizes a reunion.
